deities: Sheetla Devi (incarnation of Goddess Durga; goddess of protection from diseases and epidemics)

history.summary: Local shrine to Sheetla Devi documented at Dharamsal Mahantan village near Bharwain/Chintpurni in Una district, with smaller shrines to Shiva, Hanuman and others in the complex. IDENTITY PROVISIONAL: multiple shrines of the same name exist in Una district (including a Sheetla Mata Mandir on Takka Road in Una town), so this entry reflects the best-documented referent and should not be merged with Chintpurni Temple itself. Antiquity claims conflict across sources (16th century, Pandava-era, 19th-century construction by Raja Sahil Varman) and are unverified (verify). One source bizarrely conflates this temple with the Kada Dham Shaktipeeth in Madhya Pradesh (verify; excluded). CSV ERROR: the CSV 'state' column holds the town name 'Una'; the temple is in Himachal Pradesh.

name: Sheetla Devi Temple
town_description: Dharamsal Mahantan is a village near Bharwain in Una district, close to the Chintpurni pilgrimage town. The Sheetla Devi temple here stands on a small hillock with views over the surrounding area, near other Devi shrines of the region.

travel.airport: Kangra (Gaggal) Airport, then road via Una-Chintpurni road
travel.road: Near Bharwain on the Una-Chintpurni road; coordinates approximate (verify)
